ACF.note: ASIC states 312,192,848 ordinary shares as at 16 June, before the 18 June raise. The launch presentation rounds this to 312.2m and separately includes 7,878,394 planned AGIS vendor shares in its pro forma capital structure. Those vendor shares are noncash acquisition consideration and must be added separately to full transaction dilution; they are not placement or SPP shares. Appendix 2A dated 25 June independently reconciles the pre-placement count as 350,654,545 post-tranche-1 shares less 38,461,697 tranche-1 shares.

29M.note: ASIC reports 1,372,336,435 ordinary shares as at 19 January, the final trading day before the 20 January entitlement offer.
